findings.evidence: "Run the resolver install/check, applicable tests, type checks, build, and security audit after each cohort."
findings.fix: Compress to "run the project's verification gates (install, tests, typecheck, build, audit) after each cohort"; the expert content is the stop-on-failure rule and gate ordering, not the enumeration of standard gates.

findings.evidence: "Multiple manifests may belong to different managers; never infer ownership from file presence alone."
findings.fix: Add the conflict procedure: when several lockfiles or manifests coexist, prefer the lockfile the packageManager field or the CI install command writes; if evidence still conflicts, ask the user rather than guess.

findings.evidence: "A lockfile generated by another package manager or version may silently alter the resolved graph and make builds irreproducible."
findings.fix: Add the non-obvious detection cue (lockfileVersion field change, wholesale diff churn on a single-package update) so each failure-mode bullet teaches a check, not a fact the model already knows.

findings.evidence: "Node: use `taze` for candidate discovery and scoped writes; recurse only after confirming workspace scope. See [Node workflow](references/node.md)."
findings.fix: Add an Available scripts entry at the Node step: run scripts/check-tool.sh taze "npm install -g taze" to verify availability and scripts/run-taze.sh for scoped discovery/writes; neither SKILL.md nor references/node.md mentions the bundled scripts today, so the agent never loads them.

findings.evidence: "Node: use `taze` for candidate discovery and scoped writes"
findings.fix: State the fallback default: if taze is not installed, discover candidates with the owning manager (npm outdated, pnpm outdated, yarn outdated) instead of leaving discovery undefined.

findings.evidence: "my deps are kinda old, can you update the safe ones and flag anything risky?"
findings.fix: Ship small fixtures under evals/files/ (a package.json with mixed pin styles, a pyproject.toml plus poetry.lock) and list them in each eval's files so assertions can be checked against concrete inputs.

findings.evidence: "Run the resolver install/check, applicable tests, type checks, build, and security audit after each cohort."
findings.fix: Define the no-gate fallback: when a repository has no tests or typecheck configured, record "no <gate> configured" in the report instead of treating the gate as passed.
